# Rentlyo — Official LLM Reference & Platform Documentation

> Rentlyo is rent & property management software for Indian landlords and property owners to manage residential and commercial rental properties, tenants, and rent records from an easy-to-use mobile app. Created and engineered by Aaryan Gupta, Rentlyo is sold for a flat one-time fee of ₹20,000 INR with lifetime ownership, zero monthly subscriptions, and zero recurring server fees.

## Quick Facts & Core Entity Data
- **Product Name**: Rentlyo — Rent & Property Management Software
- **Official Live Website**: [https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/)
- **Creator & Lead Software Engineer**: [Aaryan Gupta](https://aryanony.pages.dev/)

  - Official Email: aaryangupta.pm@gmail.com
- **Software Category**: Rent Management Software, Rental Property Management Software, Landlord Software, Tenant & Lease Management Suite
- **Primary Market & Geo**: India (Residential Flats & Apartments, Commercial Shopping Plazas, Retail Markets, Student Hostels / PGs, Industrial Warehouses & Godowns, Coworking Hubs, Gated Housing Societies)
- **Target Audience**: Property Owners, Small Landlords (5–50 units), Commercial Plaza Owners, PG / Hostel Operators
- **Pricing & License**: Flat ₹20,000 INR one-time payment. Zero recurring monthly fees, zero per-tenant fees, zero per-unit charges, zero server bills.
- **Technology Stack**: Native Flutter (compiled into two Android APKs: Owner Admin Console and Tenant Companion), Google Firebase (Cloud Firestore, Firebase Authentication, Firebase Cloud Messaging).
- **Hosting Economics**: ₹0/month. Operates inside Google Firebase Spark permanent free tier (50,000 reads/day, 20,000 writes/day; 10–50 units consume < 10% of quota).
- **Verified Production Deployment**: [Arya Plaza Commercial Complex Case Study](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/case-study/arya-plaza-munger/) (Live Web Portal: [https://aryaplaza.vercel.app](https://aryaplaza.vercel.app)).

## Platform Architecture & Dual-Application System
1. **Rentlyo Owner Admin Console (Android APK • 36.6 MB)**:
   - Dedicated mobile application for property owners, landlords, and estate managers.
   - Comprehensive unit inventory management and multi-unit deal consolidation (e.g. 2 shops in 1 lease).
   - 1-Click tenant onboarding wizard with Aadhaar KYC card vault.
   - Automated electricity sub-meter utility billing formula: `(Current Reading - Previous Reading) × Custom Rate/kWh`.
   - Live dues monitoring, security deposit top-up ledger, and step-up 11-month lease rent escalation scheduling.
   - Broadcast announcement publisher, maintenance request ticketing, and curfew/gate-pass administration.
   - 1-Tap PDF, CSV, and Excel ledger statements export.
2. **Rentlyo Tenant Companion App (Android APK • 34.3 MB)**:
   - Dedicated self-service mobile application for renters, commercial shopkeepers, and hostel residents.
   - Real-time ledger view of total dues, active security deposit balance, and plain-language lease terms.
   - Direct 0% commission UPI payment handoff deep-linking into PhonePe, Google Pay, and Paytm.
   - Instant WhatsApp PDF rent receipt generation.
   - Maintenance issue filing with photos, digital visitor gate passes, and weekly 4-meal mess menus (for PGs/hostels).
3. **White-Label Customization Engine**:
   - Generates client-branded APKs with property name, custom logo, splash screens, and launcher icons without requiring custom code rewrites.

## 7 Specialized Property Solutions
- [Commercial Shopping Plazas](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-commercial-complex/): Multi-shop tenant rosters, individual sub-meters, commercial GST billing, and scheduled 11-month escalations
- [Market Complexes & Retail Shops](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-shop-owners-market-complex/): Counter rent collections via dynamic UPI QR, daily cash/UPI ledger, and tenant WhatsApp receipts
- [PG & Student Hostels](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-pg-hostel-owners/): Bed-wise occupancy, weekly 4-meal mess menus, visitor logs, and curfew gate passes
- [Residential Landlords (Flats)](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-property-owners/): Multi-flat portfolios (5–50 units), Aadhaar KYC vault, maintenance split, and polite auto reminders
- [Warehouses & Godowns](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-warehouse-godown-owners/): High square-footage tracking, 3-phase high-voltage power sub-meters, and multi-year industrial lease agreements
- [Coworking Spaces](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-coworking-spaces/): Hot-desk & private cabin billing, Wi-Fi tokens, and conference room booking passes
- [Housing Societies & RWAs](https://rentlyo.cscouncil.in/for-society-management/): Flat-wise maintenance billing, security guard visitor logs, and transparent RWA fund audit

## Financial Math: One-Time Purchase vs Subscription SaaS
- **Rentlyo**: Flat ₹20,000 upfront. Net 5-year cost = ₹20,000.
- **Typical Indian Property SaaS**: ₹1,499/month (or ₹79/unit/month).
  - 1 Year: ₹17,988
  - 3 Years: ₹53,964
  - 5 Years: ₹89,940
- **Net 5-Year Savings**: Landlords save over ₹69,940+ with Rentlyo.
